html:
Unique Research · Insight / Quarterly · October 25, 2022 · Full rewrite — not a stub

ASA since 2016; China live Jul 21, 2021 (61st market). Apple: 70% discover apps via search, 65% downloads from search, avg CR ~50%; AF’17 ARPU +30% vs other channels. H1’22 China: 3,419 apps ever ran ASA, ~877/day. Oct 25’22: two new placements (Today tab top + “You Might Also Like” on product pages) roll out globally excl. China.

China Q3: Apps TTR 9.93% / games 6.19%; CPT ¥2.43 / ¥7.24; CR 67.51% / 48.76%; CPA ¥3.61 / ¥14.86 (games CPA YoY +146.9%). Shopping/lifestyle/sports CPA YoY >200%. Keyword heat: Honor of Kings >300k/day, Genshin >200k; Douyin leads apps. Overseas: app CPA $2.06 (−0.8% QoQ), game $6.99 (+8.4%). Charts in CN images — attach on ingest.

— END —
